qc.label_under_test: a size or surface modifier (tiny, small, surface, minor) describing a small physical defect or symptom on skin, walls or the body, just before the noun it modifies

neighbours.label: a size or surface modifier (tiny, small, surface, minor) describing a small physical defect or symptom on skin, walls or the body, just before the noun it modifies
fire: Flea bites are tiny red bumps on the ankles.
The plaster hides small cracks in the wall.
Sand the surface scratches before you paint.
He had a minor rash on his arm.
Small blisters formed on her heel.
Use filler for tiny holes in the drywall.
There were small sores around the mouth.
Surface rust appeared on the pipe.
quiet: Flea markets are big events in the summer.
The plaster dries slowly in a cold house.
Sand the table before you paint.
He had a blue shirt on his arm.
Small children played near her house.
Use a hammer for the nails in the drywall.
There were small towns around the lake.
New paint appeared on the pipe.

notes: Fresh size or surface modifiers before a small defect or symptom. Near misses keep 'small' before other nouns in two cases. The card also has ' oxygen' and ' deep', which the label does not cover. Not probed.
